dogecoin.text:
1/ 2013: The Birth of Dogecoin 🐶

Back when Bitcoin was under $1,000, Dogecoin launched as a meme.

🚀 No real utility
🚀 Unlimited supply
🚀 Only worth fractions of a cent for years

Then Elon Musk tweets about it in 2020, and DOGE explodes 100x in months. 💥

Lesson: Early

🚨 DOGE → SHIB → ??? 🚨

Every crypto cycle has a breakout meme coin that makes millionaires.

2013: Dogecoin was a joke… until it wasn’t. 🐶
2020: Shiba Inu was ignored… until it wasn’t. 🔥
2025: What’s next? You already know. ⚡

A timeline of meme coin history and why https://t.co/zD4zY9sjSS

🔹 Dogecoin (DOGE) – $34B MC, inflationary, needs massive hype to move.
🔹 Shiba Inu (SHIB) – $9B MC, strong community, but limited burns.
